correctness.rationale: In fence F_n, comparable consecutive pairs are bump edges in label path 1–2–...–n and cannot share label because height is two, bounding bumps by floor(n/2), hence minimum jump degree ceil(n/2)−1. For even n perfect path matching uniquely forces descending 2-letter blocks and one optimal extension. For odd n exactly one unmatched odd u yields forced ordered left/right bump-block chains and every shuffle is valid, giving ∑_{j=0}^m binom(m,j)=2^m optimizers. Only exchange of unmatched u with first block leader preserves all bump count, giving induced 2^(m−1)K2. Standard incomparable-pair inversion distance yields diameter binom(n−1,2), credited as prior. Independently enumerated all linear extensions n=3..9, optimizer counts 2,1,4,1,8,1,16 and induced degrees 1 odd /0 even; enumeration finite but combinatorial matching/shuffle proof is all n.
